name: Dani's casa

objects.text: A hammock. Dani's "five minutes" starts here.
A plant his mum told him to water. It's thriving. Nobody knows how.
Family photos. In every one Dani is in the middle, smiling, and late.
A pot of Colombian coffee, still warm. Dani made it before he "left" an hour ago.
A football. Dani says he could have gone pro. Dani also says he's on his way.
His phone charger and his shoes, by the door. One lace untied. He's still leaving.
